title: Clingmans Dome (Kuwohi) Tower Trail
map_label: A 3D walk up the paved trail from the parking area to the Kuwohi observation tower.

stops.file: 2017-05-17 13 47 42 View north along the Clingmans Dome Trail at the Clingmans Dome Information Center and Store in Great Smoky Mountains National Park, within Swain County, North Carolina.jpg
stops.title: Clingmans Dome Trailhead
stops.alt: The Clingmans Dome trail seen from the information center near the parking area.
stops.text: The route starts at the Clingmans Dome parking area, over 6,300 feet up. A steep paved path climbs to the tower.

stops.file: 2017-05-17 13 28 32 Panoramic view east and south from the observation tower on Clingmans Dome in Great Smoky Mountains National Park, on the border of Sevier County, Tennessee and Swain County, North Carolina.jpg
stops.title: Observation Tower
stops.alt: A panoramic view east and south from the Clingmans Dome observation tower.
stops.text: You have reached the observation tower at the highest point in the Great Smoky Mountains.
